title: python/src/lichen/ccp.py: Short eui64 silently truncated in slot_hash
description:
The zip operation `zip(eui64, sfn_bytes)` truncates to the shorter input. If eui64 has fewer than 8 bytes, the hash is computed over fewer bytes than specified, leading to incorrect slot assignments. Two different EUI64s sharing the same prefix would hash identically.

Fix suggestion: Add validation: `if len(eui64) != 8: raise ValueError("eui64 must be exactly 8 bytes")` or pad/truncate explicitly with a warning.
close_reason: Duplicate of dl1g - fixed by adding eui64 length validation to select_channel()
